```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r}
library(udpipe)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
path_ewt_test   <- "en_ewt-ud-test.conllu"
path_tweet_test <- "en-ud-tweet-test.conllu"
```

```{r}
model_info <- udpipe_download_model(language = "english-ewt")
ud_model   <- udpipe_load_model(file = model_info$file_model)
```
```{r}
gold_ewt   <- udpipe_read_conllu(path_ewt_test)
gold_tweet <- udpipe_read_conllu(path_tweet_test)
```

```{r}
getwd()
list.files()
```
```{r}
gold_ewt   <- gold_ewt   %>% filter(!is.na(upos) & upos != "_")
gold_tweet <- gold_tweet %>% filter(!is.na(upos) & upos != "_")
```

```{r}
build_vertical <- function(df) {
  sent_key <- paste(df$doc_id, df$paragraph_id, df$sentence_id, sep = "||")
  sent_key <- factor(sent_key, levels = unique(sent_key))
  toks_by_sentence <- split(df$token, sent_key)
  sentences <- vapply(toks_by_sentence, paste, collapse = "\n", FUN.VALUE = character(1))
  paste(sentences, collapse = "\n\n")
}
```
```{r}
vertical_ewt   <- build_vertical(gold_ewt)
vertical_tweet <- build_vertical(gold_tweet)
```
```{r}
ann_ewt   <- udpipe_annotate(ud_model, x = vertical_ewt,   tokenizer = "vertical", doc_id = "ewt_test")
ann_tweet <- udpipe_annotate(ud_model, x = vertical_tweet, tokenizer = "vertical", doc_id = "tweet_test")

ann_ewt   <- as.data.frame(ann_ewt)
ann_tweet <- as.data.frame(ann_tweet)
```
```{r}
cat("EWT gold tokens:", nrow(gold_ewt), " | EWT predicted tokens:", nrow(ann_ewt), "\n")
cat("Tweet gold tokens:", nrow(gold_tweet), " | Tweet predicted tokens:", nrow(ann_tweet), "\n")
```
```{r}
compare_ewt <- data.frame(
  sentence  = gold_ewt$sentence,
  token     = gold_ewt$token,
  gold_upos = gold_ewt$upos,
  pred_upos = ann_ewt$upos,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

compare_tweet <- data.frame(
  sentence  = gold_tweet$sentence,
  token     = gold_tweet$token,
  gold_upos = gold_tweet$upos,
  pred_upos = ann_tweet$upos,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```
```{r}
upos_tags <- c("ADJ","ADP","ADV","AUX","CCONJ","DET","INTJ","NOUN","NUM",
               "PART","PRON","PROPN","PUNCT","SCONJ","SYM","VERB","X")

compute_metrics <- function(gold, pred, levels = upos_tags) {
  gold <- factor(gold, levels = levels)
  pred <- factor(pred, levels = levels)
  cm <- table(Predicted = pred, Actual = gold)

  per_tag <- data.frame(tag = levels, precision = NA_real_, recall = NA_real_, f1 = NA_real_)
  for (i in seq_along(levels)) {
    tag <- levels[i]
    tp <- cm[tag, tag]
    fp <- sum(cm[tag, ]) - tp
    fn <- sum(cm[, tag]) - tp
    precision <- if ((tp + fp) == 0) NA else tp / (tp + fp)
    recall    <- if ((tp + fn) == 0) NA else tp / (tp + fn)
    f1        <- if (is.na(precision) || is.na(recall) || (precision + recall) == 0) NA else
                 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
    per_tag$precision[i] <- precision
    per_tag$recall[i]    <- recall
    per_tag$f1[i]        <- f1
  }

  list(
    accuracy = mean(as.character(gold) == as.character(pred)),
    confusion_matrix = cm,
    per_tag = per_tag
  )
}

results_ewt   <- compute_metrics(compare_ewt$gold_upos,   compare_ewt$pred_upos)
results_tweet <- compute_metrics(compare_tweet$gold_upos, compare_tweet$pred_upos)

cat("Overall accuracy on FORMAL text (EWT):    ", round(results_ewt$accuracy * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Overall accuracy on INFORMAL text (Tweet):", round(results_tweet$accuracy * 100, 2), "%\n")
```
```{r}
write.csv(results_ewt$per_tag,   "per_tag_results_EWT.csv",   row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(results_tweet$per_tag, "per_tag_results_Tweet.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(results_ewt$confusion_matrix),   "confusion_matrix_EWT.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(results_tweet$confusion_matrix), "confusion_matrix_Tweet.csv")
```

```{r}
chart_data <- bind_rows(
  results_ewt$per_tag   %>% mutate(domain = "Formal (EWT)"),
  results_tweet$per_tag %>% mutate(domain = "Informal (Tweet)")
)

ggplot(chart_data, aes(x = tag, y = f1, fill = domain)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "POS Tagging F1 Score by Tag: Formal vs. Informal Text",
       x = "POS Tag", y = "F1 Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave("pos_f1_comparison.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
set.seed(42)
errors_tweet <- compare_tweet %>% filter(gold_upos != pred_upos)
sample_errors <- errors_tweet %>% sample_n(min(30, nrow(errors_tweet)))
write.csv(sample_errors, "tweet_error_sample_for_manual_review.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(udpipe)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
drop_data <- results_ewt$per_tag %>%
  select(tag, f1_ewt = f1) %>%
  left_join(results_tweet$per_tag %>% select(tag, f1_tweet = f1), by = "tag") %>%
  mutate(f1_drop = f1_ewt - f1_tweet) %>%
  arrange(desc(f1_drop))

ggplot(drop_data, aes(x = reorder(tag, -f1_drop), y = f1_drop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "F1 Score Drop per POS Tag (Formal to Informal Text)",
       x = "POS Tag", y = "F1 Drop (EWT minus Tweet)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave("pos_f1_drop_per_tag.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
error_categories <- data.frame(
  category = c("Twitter-specific artifacts\n(mentions, URLs, hashtags, RT)",
               "Non-standard capitalization",
               "Non-standard spelling/shorthand",
               "Lexical ambiguity/slang",
               "Other"),
  count = c(18, 4, 3, 3, 2)
)

ggplot(error_categories, aes(x = reorder(category, -count), y = count, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Categorization of POS Tagging Errors on Tweets (n = 30 sample)",
       x = NULL, y = "Number of Errors") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

ggsave("error_category_breakdown.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
